title: Chunk 13: questions at the start
intro: Everything chunk 13 needs answered before it starts, by the role that owns each.

questions.text: How long is a deleted mail kept before it is gone for good?

options.label: 30 days
options.why: Short and common; the trash stays small, and a mistake is still undone within a month.

options.label: 90 days
options.why: Safer for slow-to-notice mistakes; the trash grows three times as large.

options.label: Until the trash is emptied
options.why: Nothing is lost until the person empties the trash; storage grows without limit.

questions.why: Matches what the big providers do.

questions.text: Which icon marks an unread thread?

options.label: A dot
options.why: A coloured dot before the sender; reads at a glance at any width.

options.label: Bold text only
options.why: The sender and subject in bold; quieter, but easy to miss on a narrow window.

questions.why: A dot reads at a glance in the narrow layout, where bold text is easy to miss.

questions.text: Which sync runs first on start?

options.label: Inbox
options.why: Fetches the inbox first, so the first screen fills fastest.

options.label: Sent
options.why: Fetches sent mail, which replies and threads draw on.

options.label: Every folder
options.why: Every folder at once; complete, but the first screen waits longest.

questions.why: The inbox is what the person looks at first; the rest can follow.
